text:
It can be really frustrating and demotivating when you see others being favored unfairly, especially when it affects your own work and relationships with your manager.

Firstly, take a deep breath and acknowledge that your feelings are valid. It's normal to feel upset when you see unfairness.

Now, let's explore some possible ways to address this situation. Have you considered talking to your manager about your concerns? Sometimes, managers are not aware of the impact their favoritism is having on others. 

Another option is to focus on your own work and performance. By consistently delivering high-quality results and taking on additional responsibilities, you can demonstrate your value to your manager and the organization.

Lastly, if you feel comfortable, you could also talk to HR or a trusted colleague about your concerns. They may be able to offer guidance or support in addressing the issue.

How do these suggestions sound?
